Olá Gemini, eu tenho este APP que me ajuda a acelerar a produção de documentos da minha equipe, dado que nosso sistema interno ainda não é automatizado para isso.
Este APP já está operacional e funcionando, mas nosso projeto agora será melhorá-lo e adicionar novas funcionalidades e ainda manter simples de uso.
O APP recebe informações de formulários padronizados do nosso CRM e a partir destas informações preenche os documentos.
Ele permite fazer isso de forma individual e também de lote para facilitar a produção de diversos documentos.
Vamos precisar melhorar a versão já existente para algo mais seguro, estável e escalável, melhorar a interface e incluir novas funcionalidades para produção de documentos para clientes PJ, mudanças de endereço e um modelo de OS automatizada também de acordo com as informações já presentes na aplicação atual.
Analise a aplicação e vamos começar a trabalhar nas melhorias.

**Developing a Strategy**

I'm currently focused on the overarching strategy for this transition. The goal is to evolve a single-file HTML/JS application, which generates printable PDFs, into a modern React application. My immediate focus is on ensuring the new application is robust, scalable, and incorporates TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. I have not explored any new avenues recently.


**Mapping Feature Requirements**

I've been mapping the feature requirements for the new application.  My goal is to support existing functions like individual and batch entry, as well as the OS text generator.  The current single-file app has basic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS, but the new app needs to be modernized. The prompt suggested I focus on the current application first, which will be helpful. The UI/UX is something I'm keeping in mind.


**Evaluating A4 Output**

The output as A4 pages is my next focus. I'm exploring the hardcoded data objects, `PLAN_DETAILS` and `TV_PLANS`. The pain points of the current single-file app are mounting. Maintaining it is tough, and there's a lack of type safety and mixed print styles. Also, manually manipulating the DOM is time-consuming.


**Structuring the Project**

I'm currently structuring the project into logical components and features.  I've defined components for reusable UI elements, like input fields and buttons.  Specific logic for individual and batch entry is being encapsulated within features, while the critical part, the document templates, will be React components rendering exclusively for print or preview. I'm focusing on converting the HTML strings to React components.


**Defining Print Behavior**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the print behavior within React. The old app uses a hidden div for preview, but I'm thinking of a more elegant solution. My plan is to use a state variable, `printData`, to trigger rendering of Document components in a specific area visible only during print. Simultaneously, the UI controls will be hidden during print.



**Defining File Structure**

My focus has shifted to the proposed file structure and the roles of each component. I'm extracting parsing logic into `utils/parser.ts` and building reusable UI components like buttons, inputs, selects, and text areas. The document templates, `TermoAdesao.tsx` and `TermoLocacao.tsx`, need to replicate the HTML exactly. Keeping inline styles or print-specific Tailwind classes seems the most effective approach for print consistency. I'm organizing form handling within `IndividualForm.tsx` and text processing in `BatchProcessor.tsx` and `OSGenerator.tsx`. The main layout with tab switching and the Print Container is taking shape in `App.tsx`.


**Defining Print Styles**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the print styles, focusing on a robust A4 layout. With the CDN setup, standard utility classes are the way to go. I plan to add custom print styles in a `<style>` tag in `index.html` to guarantee perfect A4 sizing, as Tailwind's print support is limited.

I'm also working on refining the parser, with stronger typing, and simplifying the navigation bar to a top bar. I am checking the current project against the constraints, and will proceed to fine-tune the print styles for accurate output.


**Implementing `PLAN_DETAILS`**

I'm now focusing on refining the `PLAN_DETAILS` structure. I'll maintain the existing hardcoded sub-service structure within `constants.ts` for backward compatibility. Simultaneously, I'll ensure the code handles this data flexibly, adapting to potential future changes and avoiding hardcoding sub-service assumptions across the codebase.
